entities.name: Neighborhood Detail Template
entities.description: A template in LLaGA that offers a detailed examination of the central node and its immediate surroundings.

entities.name: Hop-Field Overview Template
entities.description: A template in LLaGA that provides a summarized perspective of a node’s neighborhood, expandable to broader areas.

entities.description: Large Language Models used as the processing component in the described GraphRAG pipelines.
